svg.title: Project box hookup: internal jumpers and external connections
svg.desc: Round badges pair the seven internal jumpers. Teal square badges on the boards identify P1 cavities. The external section lists P1, P2 and USB-C programming connections.
svg.text: Round numbers pair internal jumpers. Teal squares on the boards identify P1 cavities.
J and B are the access headers.
Circle numbers identify jumpers. J1 labels identify contacts.
B4 is SCK on the breakout and ground on the Sony board.
Underside · flipped left to right · row 1 up
Power off before wiring. Check continuity by pad name at both ends.
USB 5 V is breakout B9 → Sony I1. The Twist takes 3.3 V from breakout A7.

g.text: Use the cavity numbers molded into your connector housings.
P1 · Knob, Sony and spare GPIO · 8 pin
Sony EXT IN 1 via inline R10 (1 kΩ)
R10 goes in series anywhere between H9 and EXT IN 1.
Converter USB 5 V out → splitter power input.
Laptop → panel jack → splitter data input
Keep laptop VBUS separate from converter output.
Check panel enumeration with the plug both ways.
Outside the box: camera video → RCA Y → Sony REAR CAMERA IN and CAMERA IN 1. Reverse-light signal → Sony REVERSE IN.
